entities.summary: Góra Kalwaria is a town on the Vistula River in the Masovian Voivodeship, in east-central Poland. It is situated approximately 35 kilometres southeast of Warsaw and has a population of around 12,109. The town has strong religious significance for both Catholic Christians and Hasidic Jews of the Ger dynasty.
